1: ## 1. Database — Tables Migration
2: 
3: - [x] 1.1 Create migration `YYYYMMDD_staff_availability_tables.sql`
4: - [x] 1.2 Define `staff_schedules` table: `id`, `staff_member_id` (FK → `staff_members`), `day_of_week` (0–6), `is_working` boolean, `starts_at` time, `ends_at` time, `created_at`, `updated_at`
5: - [x] 1.3 Add CHECK constraint: when `is_working = true`, `starts_at` and `ends_at` must be non-null and `starts_at < ends_at`; when `is_working = false`, both must be null
6: - [x] 1.4 Add UNIQUE constraint `(staff_member_id, day_of_week)` on `staff_schedules`
7: - [x] 1.5 Add index `idx_staff_schedules_staff_member_id` on `staff_schedules (staff_member_id)`
8: - [x] 1.6 Add partial index `idx_staff_schedules_working` on `staff_schedules (staff_member_id, day_of_week) WHERE is_working = true`
9: - [x] 1.7 Define `staff_schedule_exceptions` table: `id`, `staff_member_id` (FK → `staff_members`), `exception_date` date, `exception_type` text (`day_off` | `custom_hours`), `starts_at` time, `ends_at` time, `reason` text, `created_at`, `updated_at`
10: - [x] 1.8 Add CHECK constraint: when `exception_type = 'day_off'`, times must be null; when `exception_type = 'custom_hours'`, times must be non-null and `starts_at < ends_at`
11: - [x] 1.9 Add UNIQUE constraint `(staff_member_id, exception_date)` on `staff_schedule_exceptions`
12: - [x] 1.10 Add index `idx_staff_schedule_exceptions_staff_date` on `staff_schedule_exceptions (staff_member_id, exception_date)`
13: - [x] 1.11 Enable RLS on both tables
14: - [x] 1.12 Grant SELECT on both tables to `authenticated` (no INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE)
15: - [x] 1.13 Create RLS policy: authenticated SELECT on `staff_schedules` using `true`
16: - [x] 1.14 Create RLS policy: authenticated SELECT on `staff_schedule_exceptions` using `true`
17: 
18: ## 2. Database — RPC Functions Migration
19: 
20: - [x] 2.1 Create migration `YYYYMMDD_staff_availability_rpc.sql`
21: - [x] 2.2 Create `admin_set_staff_schedule(p_staff_member_id uuid, p_schedule jsonb)` SECURITY DEFINER: validate caller is admin, delete all existing rows for staff member, bulk insert the 7-day schedule array atomically, return inserted rows
22: - [x] 2.3 Create `admin_upsert_staff_schedule_exception(p_staff_member_id uuid, p_exception_date date, p_exception_type text, p_starts_at time, p_ends_at time, p_reason text)` SECURITY DEFINER: validate caller is admin, upsert on `(staff_member_id, exception_date)` conflict, return the upserted row
23: - [x] 2.4 Create `admin_delete_staff_schedule_exception(p_staff_member_id uuid, p_exception_date date)` SECURITY DEFINER: validate caller is admin, delete the matching exception, return deleted row id
24: - [x] 2.5 Apply both migrations to remote with `npx supabase db push`
25: 
26: ## 3. Service Layer
27: 
28: - [x] 3.1 Create `src/services/staffAvailability.ts`
29: - [x] 3.2 Implement `getStaffWeeklySchedule(staffId: string)` — SELECT from `staff_schedules` where `staff_member_id = staffId` ordered by `day_of_week`
30: - [x] 3.3 Implement `setStaffWeeklySchedule(staffId: string, schedule: StaffScheduleDay[])` — call `admin_set_staff_schedule` RPC
31: - [x] 3.4 Implement `listStaffExceptions(staffId: string)` — SELECT from `staff_schedule_exceptions` where `staff_member_id = staffId` ordered by `exception_date`
32: - [x] 3.5 Implement `addStaffException(staffId: string, exception: StaffExceptionInput)` — call `admin_upsert_staff_schedule_exception` RPC
33: - [x] 3.6 Implement `removeStaffException(staffId: string, exceptionDate: string)` — call `admin_delete_staff_schedule_exception` RPC
34: - [x] 3.7 Export all functions and types from `src/services/index.ts`
35: 
36: ## 4. Hook
37: 
38: - [x] 4.1 Create `src/hooks/useStaffAvailability.ts`
39: - [x] 4.2 Implement hook accepting `staffId: string`
40: - [x] 4.3 Load weekly schedule and exceptions on mount
41: - [x] 4.4 Expose `schedule`, `exceptions`, `isLoading`, `isSaving`, `errorMessage`, `successMessage`
42: - [x] 4.5 Implement `saveSchedule(days: StaffScheduleDay[])` — calls service, updates state, sets feedback
43: - [x] 4.6 Implement `addException(exception: StaffExceptionInput)` — calls service, refreshes exceptions list, sets feedback
44: - [x] 4.7 Implement `removeException(exceptionDate: string)` — calls service, refreshes exceptions list, sets feedback
45: - [x] 4.8 Track dirty state: `isDirty` becomes true when schedule is edited but not yet saved
46: - [x] 4.9 Export hook from `src/hooks/index.ts`
47: 
48: ## 5. UI Components
49: 
50: - [x] 5.1 Create `src/components/availability/TimeRangeInput.tsx` — start/end time pair inputs with 30-min step, validates `starts_at < ends_at`, shows error in Spanish
51: - [x] 5.2 Create `src/components/availability/DayScheduleRow.tsx` — one row: day label (Spanish short name), toggle for `is_working`, conditional `TimeRangeInput`
52: - [x] 5.3 Create `src/components/availability/WeeklyScheduleEditor.tsx` — renders 7 `DayScheduleRow` components, "Guardar horario" submit button, dirty-state indicator
53: - [x] 5.4 Create `src/components/availability/ExceptionDateForm.tsx` — date picker, exception type selector (`day_off` / `custom_hours`), conditional `TimeRangeInput` for custom hours, "Agregar" submit
54: - [x] 5.5 Create `src/components/availability/ExceptionDateList.tsx` — scrollable list of existing exceptions, each row shows date, type, times (if any), and "Eliminar" button
55: - [x] 5.6 Export all availability components from `src/components/index.ts`

57: ## 6. Page and Routing
58: 
59: - [x] 6.1 Create `src/pages/StaffAvailabilityPage.tsx` — page shell, loads staff member name via existing staff service, uses `useStaffAvailability`, renders `WeeklyScheduleEditor` + `ExceptionDateForm` + `ExceptionDateList`
60: - [x] 6.2 Add loading state: "Cargando disponibilidad..."
61: - [x] 6.3 Add breadcrumb / back link: "← Volver a profesionales"
62: - [x] 6.4 Add unsaved changes banner when `isDirty` is true
63: - [x] 6.5 Export `StaffAvailabilityPage` from `src/pages/index.ts`
64: - [x] 6.6 Register route `/admin/staff/:staffId/availability` in `src/App.tsx` wrapped in `<RoleGuard roles={['admin']}>`
65: - [x] 6.7 Add route entry to route access matrix in `src/lib/routing.ts`
66: - [x] 6.8 Add "Disponibilidad" action button to each staff row in `AdminStaffPage` linking to the availability route

73: - [x] 7.4 Create `src/hooks/useStaffAvailability.test.ts` — loading state, saveSchedule success/error, addException success/error, removeException success/error, isDirty state transitions
